verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing docs confirm cards can be added to Apple Pay/Google Pay/Samsung Pay and reference a dedicated digital-wallets guide, and separately mention physical card art customization, but the evidence pack contains no detail on the entitlements/push-provisioning API process or explicit manual provisioning fallback steps. missing for 10: entitlements process documentation, push provisioning API specifics, manual provisioning fallback details, independent/hands-on confirmation of wallet integration working.
